verdict.rationale: There is no documented export feature. Indirect paths exist: API v2 and the MCP server can manage bookings, event types and schedules, which could pull data out as JSON. The fully MIT-licensed Cal.diy fork lets self-hosters keep their scheduling data on their own infrastructure, so leaving the hosted service is plausible. Missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account data export, explicit open export formats (e.g. CSV/ICS/JSON dumps), a migration-off or account-portability guide, and any hands-on corroboration of a complete export.
